newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5550/5570 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5550/5570 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5550/5570 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Monday.
The official rate for Tuesday will be 5560.
On Friday the bid/offer rates were 5540/5570, with the official dollar rate 5555 from Saturday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
The daily corridor for the rouble on the interbank market is 5497/6097 after 5495/6095.
